items.exampleEn: Escape rooms test your ingenuity and teamwork.
items.exampleZh: 密室逃脫考驗你的巧思和團隊合作。

items.exampleEn: The film offers an insightful look at family life.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影深刻地描繪了家庭生活。

items.exampleEn: His sudden anger was inexplicable to all of us.
items.exampleZh: 他突然發脾氣，我們大家都無法理解。

items.exampleEn: She accepted a conditional offer from the university.
items.exampleZh: 她接受了大學的有條件錄取。

items.exampleEn: Our plans for the summer holiday are still indefinite.
items.exampleZh: 我們的暑假計畫還沒有確定。

items.exampleEn: Speaking two languages is advantageous in many jobs.
items.exampleZh: 會說兩種語言在很多工作上都很有利。

items.exampleEn: The parcel inexplicably arrived a week early.
items.exampleZh: 包裹莫名其妙地提早一週送到了。
items.glossZh: 莫名其妙地；無法解釋地

items.exampleEn: Babies intuitively know their mother's voice.
items.exampleZh: 嬰兒憑直覺就認得媽媽的聲音。

items.sentenceEn: The meeting was inexplicably moved to Sunday.
items.sentenceZh: 會議莫名其妙地被改到星期天。

items.audioEn: For some inexplicable reason, the printer in our office only works on Mondays.
items.audioZh: 不知道為什麼，我們辦公室的印表機只有星期一能用。
items.questionZh: 這台印表機有什麼怪事？
options: It makes a loud noise every hour.
It turns itself off at night.

items.sentenceEn: Her comments on my report were short but insightful.
items.sentenceZh: 她對我報告的意見雖然簡短，卻很有見地。

items.sentenceEn: The shop on the corner has closed for an indefinite period.
items.sentenceZh: 轉角那家店已經無限期歇業了。

items.stemEn: Living near the station is ____ for people who work in the city.
items.stemZh: 住在車站附近，對在城裡上班的人很有利。

items.stemEn: The team showed great ____ in solving the problem with very little money.
items.stemZh: 團隊用很少的錢解決了問題，展現出極大的巧思。

items.passageEn: For weeks, the lights in our office flickered every afternoon. Electricians checked the wires but found nothing wrong, and the problem seemed inexplicable. Then a new colleague, Rosa, intuitively connected it to the coffee machine, which was switched on at three o'clock every day. She was right: the old machine used too much power for the office's electricity supply. The manager praised her insightful thinking and her ingenuity. Replacing the machine was clearly advantageous, because the new one also saves energy. Since then, the lights in every room have stayed steady.
items.passageZh: 好幾個星期以來，我們辦公室的燈每天下午都會閃爍。電工檢查了電線，卻找不到任何問題，這個狀況似乎無法解釋。後來，新同事 Rosa 憑直覺聯想到咖啡機——它每天三點都會開機。她說對了：那台舊機器耗電太大，辦公室的供電負荷不了。經理稱讚她思考有見地、很有巧思。換掉那台機器顯然很有利，因為新機器也比較省電。從那之後，每個房間的燈都很穩定，再也沒閃過。

questions.questionZh: 電燈的問題通常在什麼時候發生？
Rosa 認為問題出在哪裡？

referenceEn: He gave a very insightful answer.
His answer to the question was insightful.
rubricZh: insightful 表示「有見地的、有洞察力的」（例如 an insightful answer、was insightful 等）
加強語氣可寫，例如 very、really 等

items.instructionZh: 用 conditional on 造一個句子，說說你的某個計畫要看什麼條件而定。
referenceEn: My trip to Japan is conditional on getting enough days off.
Whether I buy a car is conditional on finding a job nearby.
rubricZh: be conditional on＋名詞或動名詞表示「視⋯而定」（例如 is conditional on getting… 等）
句子要說到你自己的計畫

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似例句未示範釋義：indefinite articles（不定冠詞）是文法術語義，對不上釋義「不確定的；無限期的」；本課 shadowing 用的是 indefinite period（無限期）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改示範「不確定的」："Our plans for the summer holiday are still indefinite."；「無限期」見跟讀 q12

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第一句 flickered inexplicably、第二句 the problem seemed inexplicable 連用同根字，語意重複。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 第一句刪去 inexplicably（"flickered every afternoon"），短文只保留 inexplicable；inexplicably 改由聽打 q09 "The meeting was inexplicably moved to Sunday." 提供情境，conditional 仍見於造句 q17

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項 inexhaustible、demographically、characterization 皆跨課重複；characterization 在本課 q13、q14 兩題都出現。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: q13 改為本課 insightful、intuitively、indefinite（insightful、indefinite 放得進空格但語意不通）；q14 改為先前課名詞 cynicism、abstraction、speculation（showed great ____ 不通）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：conditional 例句「Conditional sentences often begin with "if".」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「有條件的」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「She accepted a conditional offer from the university.」示範第一義；釋義為「有條件的；條件的」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：insightful 表示「有見地的、有洞察力的」（例如 an insightful answer、was insightful 等）／加強語氣可寫，例如 very、really 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：be conditional on＋名詞或動名詞表示「視⋯而定」（例如 is conditional on getting… 等）
